input: Create a photographic map of my neighborhood

gold.taskTitle: Create a Photographic Map of My Neighborhood
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to build a photographic map that visually documents their neighborhood through photos.

questions.title: What geographic boundaries define your neighborhood?
questions.description: Clarify the exact area to be covered, such as specific streets, blocks, or a named district.

questions.title: What is the intended purpose of this map?
questions.description: Understand whether this is for personal memory, community sharing, a creative project, real estate, or something else.

questions.title: What subjects will you photograph for the map?
questions.description: Determine the focus, such as street corners, landmarks, storefronts, houses, green spaces, or all of the above.

questions.title: What format should the final map take?
questions.description: Clarify the output format, such as a printed poster, a digital interactive map, a photo book, or a social media grid.

questions.title: What camera or device will you be shooting with?
questions.description: Know the equipment available, such as a smartphone, DSLR, or mirrorless camera, to tailor the shooting plan.

questions.title: What is your deadline for completing this project?
questions.description: Establish a timeline to help structure shooting sessions and editing work.

questions.title: Do you have a tool in mind for assembling the map?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a preferred platform, such as Google My Maps, Mapbox, Lightroom, Canva, or no preference yet.
